briefs: docs/round10/track-m3.md (read M30 and docs/round10/track-d0.md D0-2 and D0-3 first)
notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry, merged before M3 starts), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss), M1 (land animals), M2 (water and buckets) and this track, M3 (lightning, phantoms, creakings, copper golems, undead horses, camels, happy ghasts and allays: registry group `night`, bytes 80-95, with the horse kinds in the cow store, byte 11), where every registered family follows the D0-3 plug-in checklist, only M3 edits the cow-store horse lines, and segment m3c starts only after E2's e2a is merged into minecraft-survival and minecraft-survival into track-m3 (it may run before or after m3d, M30). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL, even where a brief says to: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log. RESTARTS: if this run was started again after a stop (the PC crashed on 2026-10-28 at 20:27 with six tracks building), the worktree may hold the current group's half-done work as uncommitted or staged changes: read `git status` and `git diff` (and `git diff --cached`) first, keep what is correct, finish the group and commit it; discard only what is broken. If cargo reports invalid or corrupt metadata, a truncated .rlib/.rmeta or a link error on a file that should exist, run `& .\scripts\cargo-slot.ps1 +target=<this track's target> clean -p <crate>` for that crate and build again. LOAD: builds now run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process.

groups.prompt: Track M3 group copper-golems-sorting (segment m3c, after E2's e2a is merged): build track-m3.md section M3-4, commit group 3. Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m3-log.md and the M3 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md
